preconditions.description: The number of vertices V must be between 1 and 10000.
The number of edges E must be between 0 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < V and 0 <= v < V and 1 <= w <= 99 for u, v, w in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must have valid vertices and weights within the specified bounds.
The source vertex s and destination vertex t must be valid vertices within the graph.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of different shortest paths from s to t.
